verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for an online IP-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers web-based filing and procedure pages for trademarks, patents, designs and e-Soleau, plus a probe showing the data.inpi.fr portal returns 403 to keyless requests. Nothing documents an API that can perform filings or match the UI's capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
